_note: What you see: Choosing how you sign in: the student with his school account, the workplace supervisor with eHerkenning, and the Service desk if it fails.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Kiezen hoe je inlogt: de student met zijn schoolaccount, de praktijkopleider met eHerkenning, en de Servicedesk als het niet lukt.
Kies hoe je inlogt. Studenten gebruiken: Choose how you sign in. Students use their school account. Training companies use eHerkenning.
Voor je rooster, je BPV-uren, je examens: For your timetable, your BPV hours, your exams and your messages.
Inloggen met je schoolaccount: Sign in with your school account
Je schoolaccount is je studentnummer en: Your school account is your student number and your password.
Voor praktijkopleiders. U keurt uren goe: For workplace supervisors. You approve hours, fill in assessments and sign the work placement agreement.
U heeft eHerkenning nodig op niveau [NIV: You need eHerkenning at level [NIVEAU]. The eHerkenning administrator in your company can authorise you.
Lukt inloggen niet? De Servicedesk helpt: Cannot sign in? The Service desk helps students and training companies: [telefoonnummer], on working days from 08.00 to 17.00.
